The software product **Data-Driven Documents (D3.js)** at **d3js.org** is provided and maintained by **Observable, Inc.** (co-founded by D3's original creator, **Mike Bostock**).

### Supporting Evidence & Provider Statements
From the official website at `d3js.org`:
* *"Built by Observable. D3 is developed by Observable, the platform for collaborative data analysis."*
* *"D3 was created by Mike Bostock in 2011. ... Mike and Philippe now maintain D3 and Observable Plot at Observable."*
* Website copyright notice: *“© [Year] Mike Bostock and Observable, Inc. ISC License.”*

record.description: D3.js is a powerful JavaScript library utilized for creating dynamic and interactive data visualizations in web browsers. By leveraging web standards such as SVG, HTML, and CSS, D3 allows developers to bind arbitrary data to a Document Object Model (DOM) and apply data-driven transformations to the document. This enables the creation of visually rich data representations that can be customized for better storytelling and analysis.
